Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm the full invite URL (paste entire URL) and the email header 'Received' time?
- Which browser and device were you using (we've seen some 404s with older IE compatibility modes)?

If this looks urgent for your payments team, I can open an expedited provisioning ticket.

Hi Samantha — quick update after ops review and a short repro:

- Root cause for 404: a CDN edge rule we rolled out yesterday incorrectly rewrote certain query strings that contain long JWT tokens. The invite URL token was truncated at the edge which produced the blank shell / 404. Ops has rolled back that rule for the affected path.
- PO link missing: the vendor account was created but the onboarding user was provisioned with a 'viewer' role that hides PO download links. I’ve requested a role patch to 'supplier-admin' which will make the PO tab visible.

Planned actions (what I did and next steps):
- Re-issued a corrected invite link and sent it to onboarding@hearthline.com (you should receive it within 10 minutes).
- Patched the role binding for the onboarding user; please check after you accept the new invite.
- Escalated to our billing ops to release the payment hold once you confirm PO visibility.

If anything still looks off after the new invite, please reply with a screenshot and I will escalate to the infra on-call. If you'd like, I can also schedule a brief screenshare with Marissa from our provisioning team.

Thanks for the fast turnaround on the W9. Apologies for the friction — we’ll get Hearthline live today.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
